title: Professional Judgment Override by Unauthorized Counselor Post-Delegation Matrix Update
scenario_text:
**Banner Financial Aid Module — Award Record (ID: B00512984)**
Name: Aisha Okonkwo | Enrollment: Half-time, Junior | Campus: Main Campus
ISIR Status: Verified, C-flag cleared | EFC: $14,200 (as filed)
PJ Override applied: Aug 19, 2026 | Override type: Income adjustment (loss of employment) | New EFC: $0 | Processed by: R. Guzman
Award adjusted: Pell increased from $0 to $3,648; institutional need-based grant added $2,500

**Google Doc — 'PJ Delegation Matrix AY2026-27' (v3, effective Jul 1, 2026)**
Section 2: Professional Judgment Authority Levels
- Income adjustments > $10,000 impact: Senior Counselor or above
- Income adjustments resulting in zero EFC: Director approval required
- Dependency overrides: Associate Director or above
[Version history: v2 (AY2025-26) stated: 'Income adjustments of any amount: Financial Aid Counselor II or above']

**PeopleSoft HR — Employee Record**
Roberto Guzman | Title: Financial Aid Counselor II | Department: Financial Aid | Start date: Mar 2023 | Supervisor: L. Pham (Senior Counselor)
Note: Promotion to Senior Counselor effective Oct 1, 2026 (approved in PeopleSoft Aug 30, 2026)

**Slack — #finaid-team (Aug 18, 2026, 3:22 PM)**
@r.guzman: Hey @l.pham — I have a student (Okonkwo) whose parent lost their job in June. Documentation checks out. ISIR is clean. Going to process the PJ for income adjustment. EFC goes to zero.
@l.pham: Sounds straightforward. Go for it. :thumbsup:
[Thread: 1 reply, 1 emoji reaction]

**Google Chat — Faculty Advising Channel (Aug 20, 2026, 11:15 AM)**
@prof.harrison: Quick FYI for advising — Aisha Okonkwo's aid package was updated yesterday. She should be clear to register for full load next term if she wants. I saw the adjustment in Banner this morning.

**Email — Subject: 'PJ Delegation Update Reminder' (Jul 8, 2026)**
From: j.caldwell@brightpath.edu
To: finaid-all@brightpath.edu

'Team — Reminder that the updated PJ delegation matrix (v3) is effective as of July 1. Key change: any PJ resulting in zero-EFC now requires my sign-off before processing. Please route these to me or Kenji. I know this adds a step but we got flagged in the program review for insufficient documentation on high-impact PJs. See the matrix doc for full details. —Jen'

**Slate CRM — Admissions Note (for context)**
Okonkwo, Aisha: Transfer student from Portland CC (Fall 2025). Scholarship: Dean's Transfer Award $1,500/yr (merit, not need-based). Enrollment counselor: M. Torres.
question: During a quarterly file review, the Director discovers this override. What is the correct determination regarding the validity of Guzman's professional judgment action on the Okonkwo record?

contributor.name: Jennifer Caldwell
contributor.title: Director of Financial Aid
contributor.domain_expertise: Federal financial aid (Title IV), SAP appeals, professional judgment decisions, institutional aid policy

choices: The override is invalid and must be reversed because Guzman lacked authority under the v3 matrix, and a Slack thumbs-up does not constitute Director approval for zero-EFC determinations.
The override is valid because Guzman's promotion to Senior Counselor was already approved in PeopleSoft on Aug 30, retroactively covering the Aug 19 action.
The override is valid because Lisa Pham (Senior Counselor) provided implicit approval via Slack, satisfying the 'Senior Counselor or above' threshold for income adjustments.
The override should be referred to the federal program review team because processing a PJ without proper delegation is a Title IV compliance violation requiring self-disclosure.
